20085.ins: Velvet earns its place in a fairytale costume through photographs - it reads deep and expensive where polyester reads flat, and the shawl is the piece that makes the character legible from across a room. Store hanging and the pile stays put.
20085.short: Red velvet Little Red Riding Hood costume with shawl included, full fairytale set, one size for 40-60 kg, deep red finish.

20101.ins: The headband does the costume work so the cutouts do not have to - remove it and the set reads as lingerie, keep it on and it reads nurse. That flexibility suits buyers who want one purchase to serve both the party and the after.
20101.short: Cut-out open-chest nurse uniform with dress, thong and headband, one size for 40-60 kg, three-piece costume as pictured.

20122.ins: No hat in this listing by design - the three pieces cover the costume, and buyers who want the cap usually have opinions about which one anyway. Polyester washes cold, dries hung, and the thong arrives matching the top and skirt.
20122.short: Polyester policewoman uniform set with top, skirt and matching thong, one size for 40-60 kg, three-piece authority costume as pictured.

20185.ins: Two combos and three colorways give this sweater set the widest configuration range in the knit category - with or without stockings, white gray or black. The bust range prints at 70-120 cm, and the open construction means the fit forgives.
20185.short: Open-chest sweater set in white, gray or black with optional matching stockings, bust 70-120 cm, one size for 40-60 kg.

20188.ins: A single sweater in three colorways is the whole costume - nothing else in the bag because nothing else is needed. The 85-130 lbs range covers most of the one-size market honestly, and the backless cut ventilates what knit usually traps.
20188.short: Backless one-piece knit sweater in white, gray or black, one size for 85-130 lbs, single-piece costume knit for cold-month wear.

20206.ins: The deep-V is unlined by design and the pictures show exactly what that means - this is a listing to buy with eyes open rather than assumptions. The one-size cut follows the category standard, and polyester recovers its shape through gentle washing.
20206.short: Deep-V hollow-out bunny girl one-piece in polyester with unlined neckline, one size for 40-60 kg, as pictured costume.

20254.ins: Off-the-shoulder shirts date the preppy look correctly - the neckline is the period detail. The pleated skirt runs an elastic waistband, so the 70-120 cm bust and 60-80 cm waist ranges are genuine rather than optimistic, unusual for the category.
20254.short: College off-the-shoulder set with pleated skirt in white, gray or black, bust 70-120 cm, one size for 40-60 kg, preppy two-piece.

20255.ins: The overlapping size bands are deliberate: a 55 kg wearer can take M for a tight fit or L for a looser one, which is a choice most one-size listings never offer. Four pieces arrive together, in black or pink patent leather.
20255.short: Patent leather bunny suit with headband, jumpsuit, bow tie and bracelet in black or pink, three sizes M to XL for 40-67.5 kg.

20271.ins: The shirt-cut top distinguishes this from the jumpsuit bunny versions - it is a top-and-bottom read rather than a single line, which suits wearers who prefer the silhouette broken at the waist. Five pieces arrive in the as-pictured colorway.
20271.short: Shirt-style chiffon bunny one-piece with headband, tie, bracelet, bra and thong, five pieces, one size for 40-60 kg.

20279.ins: One-piece sweater plus matching stockings closes the knit-costume question in a single purchase - the stockings match by construction rather than by hunting. Three colorways share the cut, and 85-130 lbs covers the range honestly.
20279.short: Open-chest backless sweater with matching stockings in white, black or gray, one size for 85-130 lbs, complete knit costume set.
